# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Cain and Abel Born; Abel Killed

---

**1** Adam was with his wife Eve, and she conceived and bore Abel. Cain and Abel grew up together.

**2** Abel became a shepherd, and Cain worked the soil.

**3** In time, Cain brought an offering to the Lord from the crops of the ground. Abel brought an offering from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions.

**4** The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering. But he did not look with favor on Cain and his offering.

**5** Cain was furious and his face fell. Then Cain rose against his brother Abel and killed him in the field.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
